title: Formally Modeling the Terrapin Attack on SSH
summary: Formal verification establishing that AES-GCM is the only cipher secure against Terrapin in ciphertext-only, known-plaintext, and chosen-plaintext models.

title: Terrapin Attack: Breaking SSH Channel Integrity By Sequence Number Manipulation
summary: Discovery of the prefix truncation attack against SSH BPP exploiting sequence number continuity.

title: A Drop-in KEM Replacement for Client Signatures in Post-Quantum SSH
summary: Post-quantum migration benchmarks and KEM alternatives for SSH client signatures.

title: Timing Analysis of Keystrokes and Timing Attacks on SSH
venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy
summary: Demonstrated that packet inter-arrival timing leaks keystroke cadence and password length.

title: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard (ML-KEM)
summary: Standardization of ML-KEM-768 for post-quantum key agreement.

title: AES Galois Counter Mode for the Secure Shell Transport Layer Protocol
summary: Specifies AES-GCM for SSH with independent 64-bit invocation counter reset to 0 at NEWKEYS.
